data_scope_note: Scope: direct quotations inside quotation marks (X said/spoke + quotes, including inverted forms); the alias table already covers the Tathāgata / World-Honored One / Shakyamuni titles (utils/aliases.py as the single source). Indirect speech and unquoted preaching (metrical gathas) are out of scope - each character's count is the full set under this scope, not a missing alias (W668 measurement: the speaking patterns of the Tathāgata line in the original text sit at the alias-scope ceiling); please state the scope when citing.
avg_sentiment_note: Scope note (W678): avg_sentiment is an accumulated lexicon-intensity value (not a normalised mean), so individual entries may exceed [-1,1] - a feature of the metric, not a data error
chapter_coverage_note: chapter_sentiment covers all 100 chapters (W691 attribution tracking set extended with Yuan Shoucheng / Jing River Dragon King / Wei Zheng / Emperor Taizong / Judge Cui, closing the ch. 9-11 gap)
